cost: Horner, Clenshaw and Neumaier O(n) arithmetic/O(1) scratch; Simpson O(evaluations) with bounded depth<=64 and fixed panel stack. Callback costs are additional.
description: Evaluate power and Chebyshev polynomials, compensated finite sums and budgeted adaptive quadrature with a separately labeled heuristic error estimate.
forward: Evaluate power and Chebyshev polynomials, compensated finite sums and budgeted adaptive quadrature with a separately labeled heuristic error estimate.

Fixed-degree Chebyshev-to-power conversion and analytic polynomial integrals provide independent identities. The harness uses the cubic [2,3,-2,1] in Chebyshev form and [4,0,-4,4] in power form on 33 dyadic points. The separate quadratic formula is an analytical relation. Native comparisons use explicit additive tolerances.
inverse: Exclude outputs outside each tagged native transition, successful nonfinite values, excess callback budgets and Simpson estimates promoted to universal guarantees. Distinct error/status observations are not numerical approximation loss.

At x=0 Horner retains c0,c1 and loses higher coefficients; Clenshaw retains an alternating even-coefficient sum and loses odd terms. Sum fibers include [1,2] and [3]. Quadrature samples permit arbitrary off-sample perturbations, so reports do not identify a unique integrand.
limitations: Finite intermediate overflow and cancellation are explicit. Simpson's local estimate can miss unsampled structure; callbacks may violate smoothness. Neither residual samples nor finite successful tests certify all functions or a shared <=10% error.
Finite tests and source-derived models are not a universal proof.
state: Keep coefficient conventions, finite results, callback evaluations, budgets and numerical assurance distinct. A successful heuristic tolerance status is not an analytical integration certificate.
